title: Hefty Tablet
description: Upon pickup, choose 1 of 3 Rare cards to add to your Deck, and add 1 Injury to your Deck.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Upon pickup, presents a choice of 3 Rare cards from your character's card pool. The chosen card is added to your deck, and 1 Injury is always added. All unchosen cards are recorded in map history.
